chunks.documentTitle: Acme Website Retainer - Master Services Proposal
chunks.content: Scope includes CMS maintenance, analytics reviews, bug fixes, and up to four hours of content updates each month.

chunks.documentTitle: Acme Website Retainer - Paid Media Exclusion Addendum
chunks.content: Paid media strategy, campaign management, and budget pacing are excluded unless approved through a signed change order.

chunks.documentTitle: Acme Website Retainer - Master Services Proposal
chunks.content: Routine support requests are acknowledged within one business day and scheduled according to severity and team availability.

chunks.documentTitle: Acme Website Retainer - Master Services Proposal
chunks.content: Hosting infrastructure, domain renewals, and third party subscription fees remain the responsibility of the client unless separately contracted.

chunks.documentTitle: Acme Website Retainer - Master Services Proposal
chunks.content: The agency will provide a short monthly performance summary covering traffic trends, analytics observations, completed maintenance, and recommended next steps.

chunks.documentTitle: Acme Website Retainer - Master Services Proposal
chunks.content: Final approved website assets created under the agreement transfer to the client after invoices are paid in full.

chunks.documentTitle: Acme Website Retainer - Master Services Proposal
chunks.content: The retainer includes one monthly account call to review priorities, recent work, risks, and upcoming website needs.

chunks.documentTitle: Acme Website Retainer - Master Services Proposal
chunks.content: Emergency production outages are triaged as quickly as possible, but after-hours emergency support requires separate approval.
